   33: ### DESI Measurement Evolution (live during this project)
   34: 
   35: The DESI central values have shifted during the project's lifetime as the collaboration released updated analyses and supernova calibration combinations:
   36: 
   37: | Date | DESI Release / Combination | w_0 | σ(w_0) | w_a | σ(w_a) | FW Tension | Session |
   38: |:-----|:---------------------------|:---:|:------:|:---:|:------:|:----------:|:-------:|
   39: | 2026-02 | DR2 (early, CMB+BAO) | **-0.83** | 0.09 | -0.45 | 0.31 | 1.9σ (FW was w=-1 then) | S22 |
   40: | 2026-03 | DR2 + Pantheon+ SN | **-0.827** | 0.063 | — | — | — | S42 |
   41: | 2026-03 | DR2 + DESY5 SN (current) | **-0.752** | 0.057 | -0.73 | 0.25 | 2.91σ | S67-68 |
   42: 
   43: **Key observation**: DESI's w_0 has drifted from -0.83 toward -0.75 (away from framework) while w_a has grown more negative (-0.45 → -0.73, away from both framework and LCDM). The error bars have tightened (0.09 → 0.057). The supernova calibration choice (Pantheon+ vs DESY5 vs Union3) drives ~0.08 systematic shift in w_0.
